extensionDescription.message: Detach the active tab to an external display with a custom window position and size.

popupDescription.message: Detach the active tab into a new window and place it on an external display using your saved layout.

popupHint.message: First use opens a separate permission page. You can also right-click the extension icon to open layout settings.

setupDescription.message: Chrome needs your permission to identify external display positions and available work areas. The extension does not read or upload screen contents.

setupInitialStatus.message: After you click the button, Chrome will show a window-management permission prompt.

optionsDescription.message: Choose the window position on the target display and size it relative to the available work area.

permissionPromptStatus.message: Choose Allow in Chrome's permission prompt…

permissionGrantedChooseDisplayStatus.message: Permission granted. Multiple displays were found; choose a target.

multipleDisplaysStatus.message: Multiple target displays were found. Choose one; ScreenSlot will reuse it next time.

settingsSavedStatus.message: Settings saved. They will apply the next time you move a tab.

defaultsRestoredStatus.message: Default layout restored: bottom left, 50% width, 50% height.

errorUnsupportedWindowManagement.message: This version of Chrome does not support multi-display window management. Please update Chrome.

errorUnsupportedWindowManagementApi.message: This version of Chrome does not support the Window Management API. Please update Chrome.

errorNoTargetTab.message: The tab to move could not be found. Return to the target tab and click the extension again.

errorUnableToDetermineActiveTab.message: Could not determine the active tab.

errorSelectedDisplayUnavailableReopen.message: The selected display is no longer available. Reopen the extension and try again.

errorSelectedDisplayUnavailableRefresh.message: The selected display is no longer available. Refresh this page and try again.

errorBackgroundMoveFailed.message: The background process could not move the tab.

errorPermissionUnavailable.message: Window-management permission is unavailable. Click the extension again and grant access on the separate permission page.

errorPermissionDenied.message: Chrome did not grant window-management permission. If no prompt appeared, open permission settings and change Window management to Ask.

errorOpenPermissionSettings.message: Chrome permission settings could not be opened automatically. Open chrome://settings/content/windowManagement from the address bar.

errorGeneric.message: The operation failed. Please try again.

errorSaveSettings.message: Could not save the settings. Please try again.

errorResetSettings.message: Could not restore the default settings. Please try again.

errorLoadSettings.message: Could not read the saved settings.

errorWindowCreationFailed.message: Chrome could not create the new tab window.

errorInvalidWindowSize.message: Window dimensions must be greater than zero.
